caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with an upper and lower section. The upper section consists of two glass-paneled doors framed by wood and decorated with a diamond lattice design. The glass panes are rendered in a light blue-gray color. Below each of these glass panels is a solid wood section featuring an inlaid diamond-shaped yellow or gold motif. The lower section comprises three wide wooden drawers, each fitted with two round brass or gold-colored handles. The cabinet stands on four turned legs and has a scalloped apron at the bottom. The wood is illustrated with rich brown tones, highlighted to reveal a grain texture. Above and around the cabinet are small, black ink architectural or decorative elements framed within the page, including a cornice, a column capital, and a section of brickwork. The background is a plain off-white or beige color, with faint pencil outlines defining the boundaries of the drawing.
title: Secretary
